title: Taxpayer and preparer penalties — Holt family
instructions: Compute the civil penalties for the Holt family's returns and their preparer. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Late return
exhibits.content: The Year 1 return showed **$20,000** of tax due with no withholding or estimates. It was filed **3 months late** (no extension), and the tax was paid with the return. Ignore interest and the minimum late-filing penalty.

exhibits.title: Understatement
exhibits.content: On another return the correct tax was **$150,000**; the return reported **$120,000**. There is no substantial authority, disclosure or reasonable cause.

exhibits.title: Preparer
exhibits.content: The preparer charged **$1,600** for the second return and took an unreasonable position (not willful). On a third client's return, the preparer willfully understated tax and charged **$1,200**.

rows.label: Failure-to-file penalty
rows.explanation: (5% − 0.5%) × 3 months × 20,000 = **2,700**; the FTF is reduced by the FTP for the same months.

rows.label: Accuracy-related penalty on the understatement
rows.explanation: 30,000 exceeds the greater of 10% of correct tax (15,000) or 5,000, so it's substantial: 20% × 30,000 = **6,000**.
